notes.safari_itp_fix: The fix addresses Safari ITP and other privacy modes that block SameSite=None cookies after cross-site Stripe redirect. Frontend now stores refresh_token in localStorage and uses Bearer header as primary auth method.
notes.token_priority: get_current_user prefers Bearer header over cookie. If Bearer is present but invalid, returns 401 (cookie is not used as fallback when Bearer is present).
notes.refresh_channels: /auth/refresh accepts token via: 1) refresh_token cookie, 2) body {refresh_token}, 3) Authorization Bearer header (last resort with valid access token)
notes.silent_refresh: Frontend interceptor catches 401s (except for auth endpoints), attempts one silent refresh, and replays the original request with new token. Only clears tokens if refresh fails AND original call was /auth/me.
